meta.title: Labels
meta.description: Create and print QR and barcode labels for inventory items.

header.title: Print labels that scan.
header.description: Select inventory items, apply a reusable setup, and print compact QR links, barcodes, text, and object images through your browser.

selection.title: 1. Select items
selection.description: Selection stays active while you search or change pages.
selection.emptyDescription: Try another name, SKU or location.

setup.title: 2. Choose setup
setup.description: Setups keep the media size, content, and positioning together.
setup.label: Label setup
setup.emptyDescription: A setup defines the paper dimensions and where each label element is printed.

preview.title: Select an item to preview
preview.description: The selected setup controls which details, codes, and images appear.

printer.title: Brother Wi-Fi printing
printer.description: Add the printer to this computer first. In the browser print dialog, select that Brother printer, the setup’s media size, 100% scale and no margins. Printing uses the installed system driver; this page does not send RAW commands directly to the printer.

designer.instructions: Drag the selected element on the label. Use its corner handle to resize it, or enter exact percentages here.
designer.chooseElement: Choose an element to edit its position and style.
designer.overlap: Move or resize the image so it does not cover the QR code.
designer.previewNote: The preview and printed label use the same positions.

errors.saveSetup: Unable to save the label setup.
errors.deleteSetup: Unable to delete the label setup.
errors.overlapShort: The object image overlaps the QR code. Edit the setup before printing.
errors.overlap: The object image overlaps the QR code in this setup. Open the designer and move or resize one of them before printing.
errors.urlTooLong: This deployment URL is too long for the label QR code. Use a shorter public origin before printing.
errors.missingImages_one: {{examples}} has no object image. Disable the image element or add the missing image before printing.
errors.missingImages_other: {{examples}} have no object image. Disable the image element or add the missing images before printing.
errors.imageRender: One or more object images could not be rendered. Check the preview and try again.
errors.imageLoad: One or more object images failed to load completely. Nothing was printed; check the image files and try again.
